name: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad
overview: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad 于2026年7月在马来西亚交易所主板完成首次公开募股（IPO），发行356,250,000股新股。公司业务线涵盖Conveyor-based AMHS、Hybrid AMHS、Transport systems及ASRS，但今年公告中未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia in July 2026, issuing 356,250,000 new shares. The company's business lines include Conveyor-based AMHS, Hybrid AMHS, Transport systems, and ASRS, but no specific operational changes for these segments were disclosed in this year's announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年7月完成IPO并在马来西亚交易所主板上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia in July 2026.
